::: {#def-numerical-var}
#### Numerical variable

A **numerical** (or **quantitative**) variable is a variable that takes
values on a numeric scale,
where arithmetic operations such as subtraction (and possibly division)
are meaningful.
Numerical variables may be further classified as
[interval](#def-interval-var) or [ratio](#def-ratio-var) variables,
and as [continuous](#def-continuous-var) or [discrete](#def-discrete-var).
:::
